g.text: Power path: 4 × IRFB3206 in parallel, high side (30 A continuous, 60 A burst)
Isolated 12 V gate drive (its 0 V rides on VOUT)
U4 on: +12 V over the module’s 0 V reaches the gates through D10 and R35; R39/C6 make VOUT ramp up softly.
U4 off: R34 pulls DRV to SRC, D6 and R38 turn Q12 on, and Q12 empties the gates through R36 in microseconds.
PCEN and DONE high: LIVE LED and U4 on.
Sensors and arm chain: both must see the magnet
ARM charges EN through R15 into C7 (about 0.8 s). When ARM drops, Q8 lets NARM rise and Q9 empties EN through R20 in about 1.5 ms.
off if VOUT lags the ramp
Labels with the same name are joined. Values and pin numbers as on ks_tht.kicad_pcb.
